## Activity

During May 2025, North City Eye Clinic recorded 582 captures. Activity was monitored through the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month.

## Image quality

There were 16 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 2.7 per cent. This indicates that most captured images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable cases should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance, with attention given to any recurring issues that may affect image acquisition or review.

## Grading

A total of 159 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. Grading activity therefore continued alongside the reported capture volume, with results progressing through review within the recorded timeframe. Overall, the available information shows that the clinic maintained planned session activity, while image quality and grading outcomes remained identifiable for ongoing operational monitoring.
